question: How much of Arc 7 is complete in the Web Novel, and what is the progress of the entire story? Is it still planned to have 11 Arcs?
answer:
For Arc 7 (as of April 2022), it is around halfway through—it might expand longer, but certainly not shorter, so around the halfway mark is accurate. For the overarching story, it is simply 7/11, roughly around half done. The roadmap for 11 Arcs in total has not changed (each arc will have different lengths). I honestly hope I don't continue this for another 10 years, but I am committed to completely finishing it until the very end.

Note: (It is 12 Arc in total for now)
